logline: Two meteorologists at South Korea's weather agency - a rule-bound senior and her free-spirited junior - fall into a workplace romance while navigating the storms of past betrayals and professional rivalries.

renewal.note: Single-season limited run of 16 episodes; concluded April 3, 2022. No sequel announced.

bollymeter.basis: Appealing workplace-romance premise with a strong Park Min-young performance, but critics noted tonal inconsistency and uneven writing dragged the execution below its concept. IMDb consensus sits at 7.1, reflecting a charming but flawed run.

seasons.review_body: Premiering February 12, 2022, on JTBC and streaming simultaneously on Netflix, Forecasting Love and Weather spent six consecutive weeks in Netflix's Global Top 10 for international TV, a commercial signal that its office-romance formula connected widely. The concept, mapping romantic turbulence onto weather phenomena at South Korea's meteorological agency, stands out for its freshness and for Park Min-young's timing. The execution takes a tougher road: tonal registers shift between procedural, melodrama, and romcom without fully settling, and the central romance takes time to generate real heat. The 7.1 IMDb rating reflects the overall take: likable and occasionally sharp, but not fully weather-proof.

episode_reviews.title: Signal
episode_reviews.review_body: Forecasting Love and Weather's premiere aired February 12, 2022 on JTBC, simultaneously streaming on Netflix, and established the show's workplace-romance formula with efficient economy. Jin Ha-kyung (Park Min-young) is introduced as a precision-obsessed forecaster whose professional rigour extends to every area of her life, and the premiere's structural intelligence is in establishing this character quality before deploying the hailstorm that the KMA's models failed to predict as the episode's thesis: imperfect systems operated by people who believe in their own certainty. The meteorological workplace was noted by reviewers as one of the more convincingly rendered professional environments in recent K-drama - genuinely procedural in its detail rather than used as backdrop for romantic comedy. The show spent six consecutive weeks in Netflix's Global Top 10 for international TV, and the premiere's commercial performance suggested a concept that connected widely even where the romantic heat took time to generate.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes Jin Ha-kyung as a precision-obsessed forecaster whose personal life is as controlled as her workstation, before an unforecast hailstorm - and a disruptive new transfer - cracks the surface. Efficient world-building; the meteorological workplace feels genuinely observed rather than set-dressed.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The KMA team scrambles to account for a hailstorm their models missed - the show's thesis on imperfect predictions landing right in episode one.

episode_reviews.title: Tomorrow’s Answers
episode_reviews.review_body: Forecasting Love and Weather’s finale aired April 3, 2022 on JTBC and was the episode that recovered the goodwill some viewers had lost in the mid-season sag. The episode resolves the central relationship between Ha-kyung and Si-woo with the same methodical patience that characterised the show’s weather-metaphor framework throughout: the resolution is earned rather than rushed, the final forecast sequence doubling as a statement of intent for both characters that used the show’s central conceit at its most emotionally precise. The IMDb audience score for the episode was among the season’s highest-rated hours, suggesting a viewer base that had been patient enough with the middle run to find the ending satisfying rather than merely adequate. The finale did not dramatically improve the show’s overall 7.1 IMDb average - the mid-season structural problems were real - but it closed on terms that honoured the best version of what the series had been attempting.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale resolves the central relationship with the same methodical patience the series brings to its weather metaphors, earned rather than rushed. The payoff lands for those who stayed through the mid-season sag, with episode 16 performing among the season’s highest-rated hours on IMDb.
episode_reviews.the_moment: A final forecast that doubles as a statement of intent for the two leads - the show's central conceit brought to a satisfying close.
